name: Moe Wars: Crimson Salmon
source:
Devil Corp is holding tournaments to test out their new nanobots known as REN. These nanobots can protect users from harm, spawn weapons, and even give them supernatural powers. Hannah gets a free paid vacation to the tournaments. To make it better her best friend Maria, who she hasn’t seen in a long time, joins her.

[From [url=http://renai.us/game/moe-wars-crimson-salmon]Ren'Ai Archive[/url]]
translation:
Devil Corp正在举办锦标赛来测试他们名为REN的新型纳米机器人。这些纳米机器人可以保护用户免受伤害，产生武器，甚至赋予他们超自然的力量。汉娜获得参加锦标赛的免费带薪假期。为了让事情变得更好，她好久不见的好朋友玛丽亚加入了她。

[来自[url=http://renai.us/game/moe-wars-crimson-salmon]仁爱档案[/url]]
